reader.requirement: A format 4 INSPECT executes as a format 2 with one ALL phrase per character of literal-4/identifier-6, each replaced by the character of literal-5/identifier-7 in the same ordinal position, all sharing the one BEFORE/AFTER phrase (so each position is replaced at most once), over every identifier-1 SR1 admits (group, alphanumeric, unsigned and signed numeric with the sign retained), with a figurative literal-5 sized to literal-4.

edition-consulted.switches: DialectBehavior.InspectBeforeFromFirstEligiblePosition (active from 2023): at 85 a BEFORE delimiter is searched from the leftmost position (beforeFromLeftmost=true), at 2023 from the AFTER-derived start
ConstructRegistry inspect-converting-to-all-2002: an ALL figurative literal-5 is refused before 2002
85 only (InspectSizeRulesCoverDataItems): a repeated character in literal-4 is refused (SR10); from 2002 it is legal and the first occurrence is used
DialectLevel < 2002: at 85 the SR7/SR8/SR9 size rules ask identifier-3/5/6/7 static sizes at compile time; from 2002 only literals (identifier sizes become run-time EC-RANGE-INSPECT-SIZE)

reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: with both delimiters, 85 measures BEFORE from the leftmost position (AYAAXAA CONVERTING "A" TO "b" AFTER "X" BEFORE "Y" is left unchanged), 2023 from the AFTER-derived start (AYAAXbb); an ALL literal-5 and a repeated literal-4 character are refused at 85 only

reader.notes: Convert maps each position in the one Region by its first index in the from-set, which equals the series of one-character ALL phrases because each matched position moves the cycle past itself. Every edition switch on the path takes the arm the 1985 text requires.

refuter.evidence: q1.cob (q1-002, --std 85): over a signed overpunch -12, CONVERTING "12" TO "56" gave V1=-56. Over S99 SIGN TRAILING SEPARATE, CONVERTING "12-" TO "56+" gave V2=[56-]: the sign position is not inspected and is retained (GR3c). Over SIGN LEADING SEPARATE +34, "+34" TO "-78" gave V3=[+78]. An ODO group with the object inside gave G2=[4ccAA]. q3.cob: a figurative literal-4, SPACE TO "x", gave V1=[AxBxCx] (SR3: a one-character item). A literal-5 ZERO sized to literal-4 gave V2=[0x0xCx]. QUOTES gave V3. A numeric-edited identifier-1 ZZ9.99 gave V4=[*12,70], and an alphanumeric-edited XXBXX gave V5=[Ab-CD]. q2: function-identifiers as identifier-6 and identifier-7 gave F3=[cbacba]. Refusals, all EXIT 65: rc two BEFORE phrases on CONVERTING (SR4); rm a second CONVERTING pair; ro and rn CONVERTING mixed with TALLYING or REPLACING; rl a size mismatch (SR9). The G (2:) CONVERTING space-fill (q5 M3=[5ccc  ]) matches the format 2 result on the same item (M1), so the GR18 equivalence holds.
